lines.text: He's too cheap to buy lunch.

data.define: Describes a stingy person; it can also mean low quality.

example.text: He's too cheap to buy lunch.

misuse.text: Don't call grandma 'cheap' for using coupons.

data.l1_hook: Dia tidak pernah bayar makan siang, 'cheap'!
data.l1_ex: Dia terlalu 'cheap' untuk membeli makan siang.

native.tip: “cheap” = pelit; kikir. Contoh: “He's too cheap to buy lunch.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “cheap”?
“cheap” = pelit; kikir.
Contoh: “He's too cheap to buy lunch.” (Dia terlalu 'cheap' untuk membeli makan siang.)
